script: Heads up, the biggest problem's the M80 — a southbound closure with a queue around seven hundred metres back, so heavy delays there. The Ring Road's crawling too, short queues building through the usual spots. If you're on the Princes Freeway it's slow going with congestion the whole way. And the Mordialloc Freeway is tied up with a breakdown, so a rough run across the main corridors.
